site.launch: the payments cutover to OpenVibe.Billing; checkout stays closed until then

meanwhile.label: Subscriptions on OpenVibe.Live
meanwhile.note: Channel subscriptions exist on Live today.

liveness.means: the process answers and reports its release and the outbox status from its database; it checks no dependency

drains: outbox relay, Network key refresh and metrics stopped
HTTP server closed, then the database

resumes.what: entitlement projections due for re-confirmation with Billing are refreshed
OpenVibe.Events redelivers billing.entitlement.changed, billing.subscription.canceled and billing.transaction.reversed that were pending during the stop (at least once, deduped by event_id)
unsent events in the outbox table go to OpenVibe.Events once the relay starts (at least once; Events dedupes by event_id)
OpenVibe.Events redelivers network.account.export_requested and network.account.deleted that were pending during the stop (at least once; account_data_events applies each export and deletion once)

conditions: automatic: ovhost deploy puts the previous sha back and restarts again when the ready URL does not answer 2xx within ready.timeoutSeconds after the restart (exit 3)
rollback.window: automatic only while ovhost waits for readiness after the restart (30 s in host.example.json); manual afterwards, as long as no blocker applies
blockers: idx_vip_rules_resource (one active rule per resource) was replaced by a per-creator unique index: a release from before it recreates the narrower index, which fails at boot once two creators gate the same resource

leases.none: no claims: one process owns vip.db (better-sqlite3, single writer)

notes: Memberships (ADR-012): plans, immutable versioned plan terms, perks, product bindings, member preferences and gated-resource policy. OpenVibe.Billing holds subscriptions, charges, renewals, refunds and the canonical entitlements; VIP keeps a short-lived projection of them (valid_until, authoritative fallback, 'unknown' never authorizes). Alpha: deployed internally (loopback only), not launched publicly: openvibe.vip serves the OpenVibe.Sites placeholder until the launch rule holds.
